levels.clue: I have four legs and bark, but I am not a tree. What am I?
levels.hint: A common pet that loves to wag its tail.
levels.explanation: Dogs can bark and have four legs.

levels.clue: I am yellow, curved, and monkeys love me. What am I?
levels.hint: You peel me before eating me.
levels.explanation: A banana is yellow and curved.

levels.clue: I shine in the sky during the day and give you light. What am I?
levels.hint: You can see me when the sky is clear.
levels.explanation: The Sun gives Earth light and warmth.

levels.clue: I have pages but I am not a tree. You can read me. What am I?
levels.hint: You can find stories inside me.
levels.explanation: A book contains pages and can be read.

levels.clue: I swim in water and have fins. What am I?
levels.hint: I live underwater.
levels.explanation: Fish use fins to swim.

levels.clue: I am round, orange, and used in football. What am I?
levels.hint: You kick or throw me in many games.
levels.explanation: A ball is used in many sports.

levels.clue: I have two wheels and you can ride me without an engine. What am I?
levels.hint: You move me by pedaling.
levels.explanation: A bicycle has two wheels and pedals.

levels.clue: I have hands but cannot clap. I tell you the time. What am I?
levels.hint: Look at me when you need to know the hour.
levels.explanation: A clock has hands that show time.

levels.clue: I am white, cold, and fall from clouds in winter. What am I?
levels.hint: You may build a snowman from me.
levels.explanation: Snow falls during cold weather.

levels.clue: I am full of keys but cannot open a door. What am I?
levels.hint: You use me to type on a computer.
levels.explanation: A keyboard has many keys.

levels.clue: I have a long trunk and big ears. What am I?
levels.hint: I am one of the largest land animals.
levels.explanation: An elephant has a trunk and large ears.

levels.clue: I am red, juicy, and often found in salads. What am I?
levels.hint: I am often mistaken for a vegetable.
levels.explanation: Tomatoes are commonly used in salads.

levels.clue: I have teeth but cannot bite. What am I?
levels.hint: I help keep your hair neat.
levels.explanation: A comb has teeth used to arrange hair.

levels.clue: I fly without wings and cry without eyes. What am I?
levels.hint: You can see me floating in the sky.
levels.explanation: Clouds move through the sky and can produce rain.

levels.clue: I am something you wear on your feet and usually come in pairs. What am I?
levels.hint: You put me on before going outside.
levels.explanation: Shoes protect your feet.

levels.clue: I have a face and two hands, but no arms or legs. What am I?
levels.hint: You can wear me on your wrist.
levels.explanation: A watch tells time and often has hands and a face.

levels.clue: I am sweet, cold, and often served in a cone. What am I?
levels.hint: I melt if you leave me in the sun.
levels.explanation: Ice cream is a frozen dessert.

levels.clue: I have feathers, wings, and lay eggs. What am I?
levels.hint: Many of my kind can fly.
levels.explanation: Birds have feathers and lay eggs.

levels.clue: I have a neck but no head and hold liquid. What am I?
levels.hint: You can drink water from me.
levels.explanation: A bottle has a neck and holds liquids.

levels.clue: I am green, leafy, and often used in salads. What am I?
levels.hint: I am a common salad ingredient.
levels.explanation: Lettuce is a leafy green vegetable.

levels.clue: I can be cracked, made, told, and played. What am I?
levels.hint: People often laugh after hearing me.
levels.explanation: A joke can be cracked, made, told, or played.

levels.clue: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
levels.hint: Think about walking.
levels.explanation: Each step you take leaves a footprint or marks your journey.

levels.clue: I get wetter the more I dry. What am I?
levels.hint: You use me after a shower.
levels.explanation: A towel becomes wet while drying you.

levels.clue: I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and rivers but no water. What am I?
levels.hint: You use me to find places.
levels.explanation: A map represents cities, forests, and rivers.

levels.clue: I am always in front of you but can never be seen. What am I?
levels.hint: You cannot see me yet, but I am always coming.
levels.explanation: The future is ahead of us but cannot be seen.

levels.clue: I have one eye but cannot see. What am I?
levels.hint: Thread often passes through my eye.
levels.explanation: A needle has an eye for threading.

levels.clue: I have branches but no fruit, trunk, or leaves. What am I?
levels.hint: People keep money with me.
levels.explanation: A bank has branches but they are not tree branches.

levels.clue: I am lighter than a feather, but even the strongest person cannot hold me for long. What am I?
levels.hint: You do this every moment without thinking.
levels.explanation: A breath is light, but you cannot hold it indefinitely.

levels.clue: I have a head and a tail but no body. What am I?
levels.hint: You can flip me to make a choice.
levels.explanation: A coin has a heads side and a tails side.

levels.clue: I go up but never come down. What am I?
levels.hint: Everyone gets more of me as time passes.
levels.explanation: Your age increases over time.

levels.clue: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?
levels.hint: You may hear me repeated in mountains.
levels.explanation: An echo repeats a sound after it bounces back.

levels.clue: I have many rings but no fingers. What am I?
levels.hint: My rings can tell you how old I am.
levels.explanation: Tree trunks contain growth rings.

levels.clue: I am taken from a mine and locked inside wood. What am I?
levels.hint: You use me to write or draw.
levels.explanation: Pencil graphite comes from a mineral and is enclosed in wood.

levels.clue: I have keys but open no locks, pedals but no wheels, and I only sing when someone touches me. What am I?
levels.hint: I am a large musical instrument with black and white keys.
levels.explanation: A piano has keys and foot pedals, and it makes music only when played.

levels.clue: I am an odd number. Take away one letter and I become even. What number am I?
levels.hint: Remove the first letter of my name.
levels.explanation: SEVEN becomes EVEN when S is removed.

levels.clue: I can travel around the world while staying in one corner. What am I?
levels.hint: You may find me on an envelope.
levels.explanation: A stamp stays on an envelope while the envelope travels.

levels.clue: I am a collection of words arranged to help you understand their meanings. What am I?
levels.hint: You look inside me when you do not know a word.
levels.explanation: A dictionary gives definitions and information about words.

levels.clue: I am full of holes but I can still hold water. What am I?
levels.hint: You might use me while washing dishes.
levels.explanation: A sponge contains many holes but absorbs and holds water.

levels.clue: I am not alive, but I grow. I do not have lungs, but I need air. What am I?
levels.hint: Water can make me disappear.
levels.explanation: Fire grows and needs oxygen to burn.

levels.clue: I have a thumb and four fingers but I am not alive. What am I?
levels.hint: You wear me on your hand.
levels.explanation: A glove has spaces for a thumb and four fingers.

levels.clue: I disappear as soon as you say my name. What am I?
levels.hint: Speaking breaks me.
levels.explanation: Silence ends when someone speaks.

levels.clue: I am always running but never get tired, and I have a bed but never sleep. What am I?
levels.hint: I flow toward the sea.
levels.explanation: A river runs and has a riverbed.

levels.clue: I can be seen once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years. What am I?
levels.hint: Look carefully at the spelling of the clue words.
levels.explanation: The letter M appears once in minute and twice in moment.

levels.clue: I have no life, but I can die. What am I?
levels.hint: A device may stop working when I run out.
levels.explanation: A battery is described as dead when it has no useful charge.

levels.clue: I am bought to eat but am never eaten. What am I?
levels.hint: Food is placed on me.
levels.explanation: A plate is bought to hold food, not to be eaten.

levels.clue: I have a spine but no bones, and pages but no skin. What am I?
levels.hint: You can find me on a bookshelf.
levels.explanation: A novel is a book-length fictional story with pages and a spine.

levels.clue: I can make a room brighter without taking up any space. What am I?
levels.hint: You switch me on when it is dark.
levels.explanation: Light brightens a room without occupying physical space like an object.

levels.clue: I am easy to lift but hard to throw. What am I?
levels.hint: I come from a bird.
levels.explanation: A feather is very light but is difficult to throw far because it catches air.

levels.clue: I follow you everywhere in the daylight and copy every move you make, yet I vanish when darkness comes. What am I?
levels.hint: Stand in the sun and look at the ground beside you.
levels.explanation: A shadow forms when your body blocks light, so it disappears in the dark.

levels.clue: I am yours, but other people use me more than you do. What am I?
levels.hint: People say it when they call you.
levels.explanation: Your name belongs to you, but other people use it to address you.
